findings.issue: את marks פְּנֵי הָאָדֹן as the niphal complement, and פְּנֵי is plural construct made definite by the article on אָדוֹן. Bare singular rostro is grammatical smoothing of that face-complement.

notes: Tres veces en el año, niphal 3ms será visto, singular todo tu varón, Jehová, and Dios de Israel match the tokens.
